title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.56
summary: Separate Kiosk and Live Auto from camera lifecycle control so they only read the backend-owned central preview publisher.
changes: Add a read-only central preview endpoint for Kiosk and Live Auto
Remove browser-owned prewarm/start paths and canonicalize Kiosk to one preview per camera
Make camera green status depend on the central preview plus Local-HLS readiness
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.56
description: Backend-owned central preview architecture with read-only Kiosk and Live Auto consumers.
releaseNotes: Kiosk and Live Auto no longer control camera starts or restarts; the backend owns the permanent preview lifecycle and frontend consumers only read it.
